name: Grid
description: A grid primitive with fixed columns or responsive auto-fit tracks.

anatomy.description: A CSS grid root; children stretch to fill their cells by default.
columns pins an exact track count regardless of width.
minChildWidth lets the browser add or drop tracks as the container changes size.
Row and column spacing; numbers follow the spacing scale (n × 0.25rem), strings pass through as CSS lengths.

dos: Use minChildWidth for card collections that should reflow without any breakpoint code.
Use columns when the design requires an exact track count, such as a strict three-up marketing row.
Let children stretch so cards in a row share the same height.
donts: Don't combine columns and minChildWidth; pick one track strategy per grid.
Don't use Grid for tightly packed unequal-height items; use Masonry.
Don't nest a second Grid when a Stack would express the inner layout more simply.

examples.title: Responsive tracks
examples.description: minChildWidth collapses columns automatically as the container narrows.

examples.title: Fixed column count
examples.description: columns pins an exact track count for layouts that must hold their shape.

guidance.useWhen: Children distribute across columns, either a fixed track count or responsive auto-fit cards.
guidance.avoidWhen: Items flow in one line — use Stack; for tightly packed unequal heights, use Masonry.
guidance.behavior: columns pins an exact track count; minChildWidth switches to auto-fit tracks, and children stretch to fill their cells.
guidance.responsive: Auto-fit tracks collapse one by one as the container narrows, with no breakpoint code.

notes: Visual order matches DOM order, so keyboard and screen-reader users experience the same sequence as sighted users.
Grid is purely visual; add list or landmark markup inside when the collection has meaning.

apiEntries.description:
A grid layout primitive with either a fixed column count
or responsive auto-fit columns driven by a minimum child width.

props.description: Fixed column count, rendered as `repeat(n, minmax(0, 1fr))`. Ignored when `minChildWidth` is set.
props.name: columns

props.description: Minimum child width (e.g. '16rem' or 256 for pixels); enables `auto-fit` responsive columns.
props.name: minChildWidth

props.description: Gap between tracks. Numbers follow the Tailwind spacing scale (n × 0.25rem); strings are used as-is.
props.name: gap
